books.title: The Midnight Library
books.author: Matt Haig
books.description: Between life and death there is a library, and within that library, the shelves go on forever. Every book provides a chance to try another life you could have lived.

books.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
books.author: Delia Owens
books.description: For years, rumors of the 'Marsh Girl' haunted Barkley Cove. Kya Clark is barefoot and wild, but she's more intelligent and resourceful than anyone imagines.

books.title: The Song of Achilles
books.author: Madeline Miller
books.description: A dazzling literary feat that brilliantly reimagines Homer's Iliad — a tale of gods, kings, immortal fame, and the human heart.

books.title: Normal People
books.author: Sally Rooney
books.description: Connell and Marianne grow up in the same small town in rural Ireland. A story of mutual fascination, friendship and love.

books.title: The Great Gatsby
books.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
books.description: The story of the mysteriously wealthy Jay Gatsby and his love for Daisy Buchanan, amid the excess of the Jazz Age.

books.title: Little Fires Everywhere
books.author: Celeste Ng
books.description: In Shaker Heights, a placid progressive suburb of Cleveland, everything is planned — until a mysterious artist and her daughter arrive.

books.title: The Invisible Life of Addie LaRue
books.author: V.E. Schwab
books.description: A life no one will remember. A story you will never forget. Addie LaRue makes a Faustian bargain to live forever but is cursed to be forgotten.

books.title: The Goldfinch
books.author: Donna Tartt
books.description: A boy in New York survives a disaster that kills his mother. Abandoned by his father, he clings to a small painting that draws him into the underworld of art.

books.title: The Alchemist
books.author: Paulo Coelho
books.description: A shepherd boy travels from Spain to the Egyptian desert in search of treasure. Along the way he learns the true treasure is the journey itself.

books.title: The Kite Runner
books.author: Khaled Hosseini
books.description: The unforgettable story of two boys growing up in Afghanistan. A devastating tale of friendship, betrayal, and the power of redemption.

books.title: The Handmaid's Tale
books.author: Margaret Atwood
books.description: In the Republic of Gilead, fertile women are assigned to powerful men as Handmaids. Offred can remember the days before, when she was free.

books.author: George Orwell
books.description: A dystopian masterpiece about a totalitarian regime that controls every aspect of life. Winston Smith dares to think independently.

books.title: Catch-22
books.author: Joseph Heller
books.description: Set in Italy during World War II, Yossarian is a bombardier who is convinced everyone is trying to kill him. The novel that invented its own literary genre.

books.title: Beloved
books.author: Toni Morrison
books.description: Sethe, a formerly enslaved woman, is haunted by the ghost of her dead child. A powerful meditation on the legacy of slavery in America.

books.title: Norwegian Wood
books.author: Haruki Murakami
books.description: Toru Watanabe navigates love, loss, and sexuality in 1960s Tokyo. A nostalgic story of one college student's experiences.

books.title: Anxious People
books.author: Fredrik Backman
books.description: A failed bank robber holds everyone in an apartment viewing hostage. This darkly comic novel is about the absurdity of the human condition.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Ryland Grace is the sole survivor on a desperate, last-chance mission. If he fails, humanity and the earth itself will perish.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune is the story of Paul Atreides and his family's ambition to bring to fruition humankind's most ancient dream.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.author: William Gibson
books.description: Case was the sharpest data thief in the matrix — until he crossed the wrong people. Now a mysterious employer recruits him for one last run.

books.title: Dark Matter
books.author: Blake Crouch
books.description: Jason Dessen is abducted and awakens in a reality that is not his own. In this world, his life is very different — and very terrifying.

books.title: Klara and the Sun
books.author: Kazuo Ishiguro
books.description: Klara is an Artificial Friend with outstanding observational qualities who watches carefully the behavior of those who come in to browse.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.description: A lone human envoy is sent to the planet Gethen to convince its nations to join an interplanetary alliance.

books.title: Ender's Game
books.author: Orson Scott Card
books.description: In order to develop a secure defense against a hostile alien race, the government breeds child geniuses and trains them as soldiers.

books.title: The Three-Body Problem
books.author: Liu Cixin
books.description: Set against the backdrop of China's Cultural Revolution, a secret military project sends signals into space. An alien civilization captures the signal.

books.title: Recursion
books.author: Blake Crouch
books.description: A mysterious affliction called False Memory Syndrome is sweeping the globe. A neuroscientist's research into memory has been hijacked.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.description: Stranded on Mars after a dust storm, astronaut Mark Watney must rely on his ingenuity to survive and find a way to signal Earth.

books.title: Fahrenheit 451
books.author: Ray Bradbury
books.description: In a future where books are banned, fireman Guy Montag's job is to burn any that are found. Then he begins to question everything.

books.title: Slaughterhouse-Five
books.author: Kurt Vonnegut
books.description: Billy Pilgrim has come unstuck in time. He travels between his life as an American soldier in WWII and his abduction by aliens.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.description: The tale of the magically gifted young man who grows to be the most notorious wizard his world has ever seen.

books.title: Circe
books.author: Madeline Miller
books.description: In the house of Helios, a daughter is born. Circe discovers she possesses the power of witchcraft, which can transform rivals into monsters.

books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.description: For a thousand years the ash fell. In a world of darkness, an evil overlord reigns. A thief with extraordinary abilities leads a revolution.

books.title: Piranesi
books.author: Susanna Clarke
books.description: Piranesi's house is no ordinary building: its rooms are infinite, its corridors endless, its walls lined with thousands of statues.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.author: N.K. Jemisin
books.description: A season of endings has begun. Every few centuries, catastrophic climate change sweeps the land. This is the Stillness.

books.title: The Way of Kings
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.description: Roshar is a world of stone and storms. Kaladin struggles to protect his men while leading them through endless battles.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable life. When Gandalf and thirteen dwarves arrive, his life is changed forever.

books.title: The Priory of the Orange Tree
books.author: Samantha Shannon
books.description: A world divided. A queendom without an heir. An ancient enemy awakens. A sweeping epic about a world on the brink of war with dragons.

books.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.description: One Ring to rule them all. In a sleepy village in the Shire, young Frodo Baggins must begin a perilous quest to destroy the One Ring.

books.title: A Game of Thrones
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.description: In a land where seasons can last decades, winter is coming. Political intrigue, honor, and treachery await in the Seven Kingdoms.

books.title: The Bear and the Nightingale
books.author: Katherine Arden
books.description: At the edge of the Russian wilderness, winter lasts most of the year. Vasya's gifts draw the attention of forces both dark and magical.

books.title: Gone Girl
books.author: Gillian Flynn
books.description: On their fifth wedding anniversary, Nick Dunne's clever wife disappears. As the police and media descend, everyone is asking: what did Nick do?

books.title: The Silent Patient
books.author: Alex Michaelides
books.description: Alicia Berenson shoots her husband five times and then never speaks another word. A psychotherapist is determined to unravel the mystery.

books.title: The Girl on the Train
books.author: Paula Hawkins
books.description: Rachel takes the same commuter train every day, watching a couple from afar. When the woman disappears, Rachel becomes entangled.

books.title: The Da Vinci Code
books.author: Dan Brown
books.description: A murder inside the Louvre leads Harvard professor Robert Langdon on a trail of clues hidden in the works of Leonardo da Vinci.

books.title: In the Woods
books.author: Tana French
books.description: When he was twelve, something terrible happened in the woods. Twenty years later, Detective Rob Ryan investigates a murder in the same area.

books.title: Big Little Lies
books.author: Liane Moriarty
books.description: A murder, a school trivia night, and the dangerous lies that lurk beneath perfect-seeming suburban lives.

books.title: The Woman in the Window
books.author: A.J. Finn
books.description: Anna Fox lives alone. She watches her neighbors. Then she sees something she shouldn't in the house across the way.

books.title: And Then There Were None
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.description: Ten strangers are lured to an isolated island mansion. One by one, the guests share a dark secret — and one by one, they die.

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.author: Stieg Larsson
books.description: A journalist and a computer hacker investigate a decades-old disappearance in an industrialist family.

books.title: Beach Read
books.author: Emily Henry
books.description: Two writers swap genres for the summer. Augustus writes literary fiction; January writes romance. Funnier and more tender than expected.

books.title: It Ends with Us
books.author: Colleen Hoover
books.description: Lily meets Ryle, a neurosurgeon who sweeps her off her feet. But as questions surface, everything she knew is upended.

books.title: People We Meet on Vacation
books.author: Emily Henry
books.description: Alex and Poppy have nothing in common except a love of travel and each other. After a falling out, Poppy proposes one more trip.

books.title: The Love Hypothesis
books.author: Ali Hazelwood
books.description: Olive Smith fabricates a relationship with a brooding professor to convince her best friend to date the man she likes.

books.title: Book Lovers
books.author: Emily Henry
books.description: Nora is a literary agent who agrees to a month-long trip to Sunshine Falls. She keeps running into Charlie, a brooding editor from back home.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.description: The story of Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy navigating societal expectations, family pressures, and their own stubborn pride.

books.title: Outlander
books.author: Diana Gabaldon
books.description: Claire Randall is transported from 1945 to 1743 Scotland, where she meets a dashing Highland warrior and becomes embroiled in the Jacobite risings.

books.title: The Notebook
books.author: Nicholas Sparks
books.description: The story of Noah Calhoun and Allie Nelson, two lovers separated by war and class, whose passion for each other endures for decades.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.description: From the role of happenstance in human society to the ways biology and history define what it means to be human.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.description: Kahneman takes us on a tour of the mind explaining the two systems that drive the way we think.

books.title: A Brief History of Time
books.author: Stephen Hawking
books.description: Was there a beginning of time? Is the universe infinite? A great scientific thinker explores the mysteries of the cosmos.

books.title: Quiet: The Power of Introverts
books.author: Susan Cain
books.description: At least one-third of people are introverts. This book shows how dramatically we undervalue them, and how much we lose in doing so.

books.title: Freakonomics
books.author: Steven D. Levitt
books.description: A rogue economist explores the hidden side of everything — from cheating teachers to drug dealers who live with their moms.

books.title: Outliers
books.author: Malcolm Gladwell
books.description: What makes high-achievers different? Gladwell argues we pay too much attention to what successful people are like, not where they're from.

books.title: Born a Crime
books.author: Trevor Noah
books.description: The compelling memoir of one man's coming-of-age, set during the twilight of apartheid and the tumultuous days of freedom that followed.

books.title: The Immortal Life of Henrietta Lacks
books.author: Rebecca Skloot
books.description: Henrietta Lacks's cells were taken without her knowledge and became one of the most important tools in medicine. Her story was ignored for decades.

books.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
books.author: Jared Diamond
books.description: Why did Eurasians conquer the Americas and not vice versa? Diamond argues that geography and environment shaped the modern world.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: Practical strategies to form good habits, break bad ones, and master the tiny behaviors that lead to remarkable results.

books.title: The Power of Now
books.author: Eckhart Tolle
books.description: Living in the now is the truest path to happiness and enlightenment. A profound guide to spiritual awakening.

books.title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
books.author: Mark Manson
books.description: A superstar blogger cuts through the crap to show us how to stop trying to be positive all the time.

books.title: Man's Search for Meaning
books.author: Viktor E. Frankl
books.description: A psychiatrist's memoir of life in Nazi death camps, with lessons for spiritual survival. Devastating yet life-affirming.

books.title: The Four Agreements
books.author: Don Miguel Ruiz
books.description: Based on ancient Toltec wisdom, The Four Agreements offer a powerful code of conduct that can transform our lives.

books.title: Mindset: The New Psychology of Success
books.author: Carol S. Dweck
books.description: World-renowned psychologist Carol Dweck reveals the power of our mindset — how fixed vs growth mindsets shape our lives.

books.title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
books.author: Stephen R. Covey
books.description: A holistic, integrated, principle-centered approach for solving personal and professional problems.

books.title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
books.author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
books.description: What the rich teach their kids about money that the poor and middle class do not. Financial literacy for everyone.

books.title: Becoming
books.author: Michelle Obama
books.description: Former First Lady Michelle Obama chronicles the experiences that shaped her — from Chicago's South Side to the White House.

books.title: Educated
books.author: Tara Westover
books.description: Born to survivalists in Idaho, Tara was 17 the first time she set foot in a classroom. Her quest for knowledge took her to Harvard and Cambridge.

books.title: Steve Jobs
books.author: Walter Isaacson
books.description: The exclusive biography of Apple's co-founder, based on more than forty interviews with Jobs and conversations with family and colleagues.

books.title: Long Walk to Freedom
books.author: Nelson Mandela
books.description: The autobiography of the anti-apartheid leader, tracing his remarkable journey from childhood to the presidency of South Africa.

books.title: Shoe Dog
books.author: Phil Knight
books.description: The candid memoir of how Phil Knight founded Nike. Starting with a crazy idea, he tells the story of building one of the most iconic brands.

books.title: The Glass Castle
books.author: Jeannette Walls
books.description: The memoir of a woman who grew up with parents whose ideals and stubborn nonconformity were sometimes inspiring, sometimes devastating.

books.title: When Breath Becomes Air
books.author: Paul Kalanithi
books.description: At age thirty-six, on the verge of completing a decade's worth of training as a neurosurgeon, Paul Kalanithi was diagnosed with lung cancer.

books.title: The Diary of a Young Girl
books.author: Anne Frank
books.description: The writings of a Jewish girl who hid from the Nazis in Amsterdam for two years. One of the most moving and widely read accounts of the Holocaust.

books.author: David McCullough
books.description: The intensely human story of those who marched with George Washington in the year of the Declaration of Independence.

books.title: The Silk Roads
books.author: Peter Frankopan
books.description: Far from being forgotten backwaters, Central Asia and the Middle East were the very crossroads of civilization.

books.title: The Devil in the White City
books.author: Erik Larson
books.description: Two men at the 1893 Chicago World's Fair — one an architect, the other a serial killer. Their stories unfold in parallel.

books.title: Team of Rivals
books.author: Doris Kearns Goodwin
books.description: The political genius of Abraham Lincoln, who brought his most formidable opponents together to create a remarkable cabinet.

books.title: Unbroken
books.author: Laura Hillenbrand
books.description: The incredible story of Louis Zamperini — Olympic runner, WWII bombardier, and survivor of a harrowing odyssey of endurance.

books.title: Sapiens: A Graphic History
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.description: The graphic adaptation of the international bestseller, turning the story of humankind into a vivid, illustrated narrative.

books.title: Mexican Gothic
books.author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
books.description: Noemí heads to a remote mansion in the Mexican countryside after receiving a frantic letter from her cousin. The house holds dark secrets.

books.title: The Shining
books.author: Stephen King
books.description: Jack Torrance's new job at the Overlook Hotel is the perfect chance for a fresh start. But a sinister presence begins to manifest.

books.title: House of Leaves
books.author: Mark Z. Danielewski
books.description: A experimental novel that challenges readers with its structure. A house that is bigger on the inside than on the outside.

books.title: The Haunting of Hill House
books.author: Shirley Jackson
books.description: Four seekers arrive at Hill House. The story of their decadent stay is the stuff of legendary horror.

books.title: Bird Box
books.author: Josh Malerman
books.description: Something terrifying lurks outside. If you see it, you go mad. Malorie and her children must journey blindfolded to safety.

books.title: It
books.author: Stephen King
books.description: The evil clown Pennywise terrorizes the children of Derry, Maine. A group of outcasts bands together to fight the ancient, shape-shifting evil.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.description: Victor Frankenstein creates a creature from dead tissue. But the being, rejected by society and its creator, seeks revenge.

books.title: Dracula
books.author: Bram Stoker
books.description: The classic tale of Count Dracula's attempt to move from Transylvania to England so that he may find new blood and spread the undead curse.
